workflow: Dress-then-extract references were used to author garment overlays. Final previews composite extracted layers over unchanged original base stages. Early standalone-shirt attempts were rejected.

u_idle0.fit_reference:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the ORIGINAL unicorn in image 1 by dressing it in the mint tee design from image 2. The result is an anatomical FIT REFERENCE, not a new character design.
Keep image1's exact original character position, scale, pose, head, face, muzzle, blue eyes, horn, ears, rainbow mane/tail, legs, hooves and painted texture. Do not improve, restyle or redraw the uncovered character. Same 512x512 composition with the unicorn in the same location.
Add a SMALL CLOSE-FITTING mint short sleeve T-shirt with pink stitched heart that naturally follows this specific tiny three-quarter RIGHT-FACING standing quadruped. The neckline hugs the neck BELOW the muzzle; shoulder under the mane; near foreleg emerges through a sleeve pointing DOWN and continuing along that EXACT original foreleg; far foreleg emerges at its own correct position. The shirt must not add extra arms, floating sleeve cylinders, false legs or cartoon hands. Fit the white torso, stop the hem above the hooves, leave all original legs where they are. The mane overlaps the shirt naturally. This is wearing clothing, not pinning a shirt icon on the chest.
Output transparent background. No glow, halo, shadow, haze, surface, text or extra objects. Soft violet outlines and painted shading match the existing unicorn, avoid shiny plastic fabric.
u_idle0.extraction: Use case: background-extraction. Technical sprite layer extraction from the supplied dressed unicorn. Keep ONLY the exact visible mint shirt pixels: the mint fabric, ribbed collar and sleeve cuffs, seams and pink heart. Delete the entire unicorn including face, neck skin, horn, ears, mane, tail, white legs, purple hooves and background to genuine transparent alpha. Where mane overlaps the shirt, leave its exact silhouette as a transparent cutout; do not reconstruct hidden shirt. Where the forelegs emerge from sleeves, leave the leg regions transparent; do not draw dark filled sleeve holes or new cuffs. Do not redraw, polish, reshape, move, recenter, enlarge, rotate or scale any shirt pixels. Keep original 1280x1280 canvas and the clothing's exact current position and size within it. The final is a small garment in the same lower-center area, with lots of transparent canvas, not a centered enlarged product image. No shadows, glow, haze, outlines around deleted areas, labels, grid or any other object. Preserve the shirt's exact fit from this image.

u_run2.fit_reference: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the ORIGINAL unicorn in image1 by dressing it in the mint tee from image2. This is an anatomical FIT REFERENCE. Keep the exact original position, scale, pose, face, head, ears, horn, mane/tail, skin and hooves and original painted texture wherever uncovered. Keep the entire composition and original transparent canvas framing unchanged. Do not restyle or redraw the uncovered character. Add only a SMALL CLOSE-FITTING mint T-shirt with pink stitched heart, short ribbed sleeves and collar, soft muted violet outlines. The neckline hugs the actual neck below the muzzle; mane lies in front of shirt; sleeve openings match the actual original forelegs, leaving original skin/hooves visible. No extra limbs, floating sleeve cylinders, fake sleeves that point elsewhere, billowing cloth or human anatomy. Genuine transparent background, no halo/glow/haze/shadow or text. This original unicorn is RUNNING: the shirt follows the elongated moving torso, front chest and actual two foreleg positions. Do not shift any legs. Keep the original running limb silhouette outside short cuffs.
u_run2.extraction: Use case: background-extraction. Technical SPRITE LAYER extraction from the supplied dressed unicorn. Keep ONLY the EXACT VISIBLE mint shirt fabric, collar, sleeve cuffs, seams and pink heart. Delete EVERYTHING else to genuinely empty alpha: all character skin/neck, face, horn, ears, mane, tail, legs, hooves, any bicycle/skateboard/grips/flowers/bell, all shadows/halos/haze and background. Where the mane or forelegs lie in front of shirt, leave their precise cutout shapes TRANSPARENT. Do not reconstruct hidden clothing. Do not redraw dark empty cuff interiors: preserve only the actual cloth edging around original exposed legs. Preserve this shirt's exact current shape, position, scale and colors. Do not move/recenter/enlarge/rotate/polish the shirt. Keep the same full square canvas, with the small shirt at its existing position and all other area transparent. Output contains ONLY garment pixels. No glow, shadow, haze, checkerboard, labels or extra pieces. This will be overlaid on the untouched original character, so pose registration and empty holes are essential.
